title: Resolution granting tax exemption for affordable housing at 300 West 17th Street
summary: This resolution approves a property tax exemption for an affordable housing development at Block 740, Lot 37 in Manhattan, run by a housing development fund company. The exemption lasts up to 40 years starting July 1, 2026, and requires the owner to pay a reduced tax based on 5% of gross rent instead of full property taxes. The exemption can end early if the owner violates HPD requirements or sells the property without approval.
